title: NgAutoPilot Pack Definition
description: Declarative selection layer. A pack selects skills, agents, prompts, and guardrails from the canonical source tree for installation. It is NOT a distributable bundle; plugin bundles are generated from the source, packs are installed by the CLI/TUI.

id.description: Stable pack identifier matching the plugin bundle name when one exists.

audience.description: Who this pack targets (e.g. 'Angular developers', 'Frontend generalists').

useCases.description: Representative scenarios where this pack is the right choice.

skills.description: Skill id prefixes or category dots to include (e.g. 'angular.', '_core.').

agents.description: Agent or subagent role identifiers to include.

excludes.description: Skill id prefixes or category dots to exclude after includes are applied.

dependsOn.description: Other packs that must also be installed.
